peer_positioning.text: Finnair sits in the middle of the network group on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and cash liquidity to revenue ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

Leverage is the weakest in the group: gross leverage ranks {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}}, and net leverage ranks {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}.

Coverage and cash generation are also below the group, with interest coverage ranking {{interest_coverage.peer_rank@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and FFO to debt ranking {{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}} against {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Advance ticket cover sits in the middle of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}), and capital intensity is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}.

snapshot.text: Finnair, the Finnish network carrier, ended FY2024 with revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} but weaker earnings, as industrial action in Finland led to flight cancellations in the early and late parts of the year.
The EBITDA margin fell by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is leverage against the network peers: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and ranks {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}.
